messages.subject: fileInput for .Rdata
parts:
The code below seemingly reads in an .Rdata file, but the str() shows the object in the workspace, not the str of the rdata object itself. For example, suppose my Rdata is a data frame, I was thinking expected behavior of my code would be to read in the .rdata and then show the columns of the data frame?

My goal here is to be able to read in an rdata file and then work on it just as if it were any rectangular data file.

ui.r
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Uploading Files"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
    
      h4("Uploading Files"),
     fileInput('f1', 'Choose RData File', accept=c('.RData'))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
     h4("Data Structure"),
     verbatimTextOutput("datastr")
    )
  )
))

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  dataInput <- reactive({
    if (!is.null(input$f1)) load(input$f1$datapath)
  })
  output$datastr <- renderPrint({
    if (is.null(dataInput()))  return()  else str(dataInput())
  })
  
})

Update to my own question. I see what is happening here. The code works to properly read in the .Rdata and objects that happen to be in the workspace. Suppose however that workspace I read in has in it only a data frame with an unknown name.

I want my user to be able to read in any .RData file that holds in it any data frame as the only object, and the user will be able to access that frame and do R stuff on it.
